summary: BuzzFeed, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Stock Purchase Agreement with Allen Family Digital, LLC. The company will issue 40 million shares of Class A common stock at $3.00 per share for $120 million aggregate consideration, consisting of $20 million cash and a $100 million secured promissory note. The transaction, exempt from registration, is expected to close on May 26, 2026, and proceeds will repay existing debt. The board did not state a recommendation. The filing includes resale registration rights. No premium or control change is involved. Monitor for SEC review of the registration statement and note the non-cash portion's collection risk.
